name: Bambu Lab H2D
limits_source: https://bambulab-eu.myshopify.com/products/h2d (350 C nozzle, 65 C active chamber heating); https://cdn1.bambulab.com/documentation/h2d/en/H2D_Laser_Full_Combo_20250305.pdf (120 C bed)

bed_surface.clean: Wash the cold plate with warm water and dish soap (no oils or moisturizers) using a sponge or plastic brush, rinse, dry with a paper towel; never acetone on textured PEI; don't touch the print area. Clean plate: water spreads as a film, dirty plate: it beads.

multi_material: two nozzles; AMS 2 Pro (in the AMS Combo)

camera.where: AI nozzle camera with a macro lens (other camera mounts not stated)

quirks.note: Bambu says hotend clumping usually starts when the plate was not cleaned and the model detached in the first layers.
Bambu: selecting the wrong plate type in the slicer sets the wrong bed temperature and, for the textured plate, a nozzle 0.04 mm too high.

connect.notes: Gantrel has no H2D slicing profile yet
